newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Golden State lifts Menzies gold profile.
newsitem.headline: Golden State lifts Menzies gold profile.

text.p: Golden State Resources NL said on Monday it had raised its profile further in the Menzies gold mining project in Western Australia through a joint venture with fellow miner Helix Resources NL HCA.AX.

As a result of the Helix link-up and a joint venture formed last week with Heron Resources NL, Golden State has acquired a controlling interest in the largest land holding in the immediate Menzies area in terms of greenstone exploration acreage
"The new joint ventures have significantly increased Golden State's project area from 11 km sq to 108 km sq with a large increase in drilling targets," it said.
As part of the deal, Golden State will issue 1.25 million fully paid Golden State shares to Helix for the right to enter the joint venture, the company said.
Golden State then may elect to spend A$2 million on exploration over four years to earn a 51-percent stake in the joint venture.
Last week, the company said it had reached a joint venture agreement with Heron enabling it to earn 60 percent of the Menzie project by spending A$250,000 on exploration over four years.

The Heron Resources joint venture covers seven square kilometres immediately to the south and contiguous with Golden State's existing Merrey Well holding, where partners Golden State, 60 percent, Dalrymple Resources NL, 20 percent, and Julia Mines NL, 20 percent, are test drilling.
